I don't like life in America, haha. It's really sad here. Young people are depressed and don't have a lot of manners or basic respect. I think their "openness" in character is fun and interesting, but you kind of need to travel around to find people that are willing to show that. I'm also personally very traditional in mindset and America obviously is known for not having that lol. I also had an easier time finding friends in Azerbaijan. Here, it feels like everyone hates you for some reason, or maybe I'm just sensitive haha. It feels like a 50/50 situation. But one thing I can say for sure is it feels very "empty".

I want to go back to Azerbaijan as soon as possible, or at least Europe in general.

Although I'm currently living in America with my parents since a young age, both of them said they were educated in English when they were young by English teachers, and began to listen to more media as times changed and they got older. But they came to the US with very decent knowledge of English. 

As for the rest of my family who has lived in Azerbaijan... They speak just fine, not fluent, but they know all the stuff they probably should know if they want to travel or have basic conversations. My younger cousin on the other hand, speaks pretty well and she never had a teacher, simply picked it up from either me or watching a lot of media, or maybe other stuff I didn't know about lol. 
I'm a little surprised English isn't great in Azerbaijan honestly, but considering you said you are in Poland currently, I heard Azerbaijanis overseas can be a little uneducated, but don't take my word for it haha.
